name: rail-road-regional
about: A sound text-only ad: an empty road through wheat at sunrise, the words at the top. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-road-regional`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: the headline is about the road and the picture is the road

subject_legible.reason: A straight two-lane road running through golden wheat fields toward a low sun reads instantly, clean and uncluttered.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline about regional runs through farm country sits over an open road cutting through grain fields, which is exactly the same story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large white headline on dark sky is read first and the white button second, though the vivid sunset pulls some attention and the bottom band sits empty.

looks_like_kit.reason: The navy footer band, navy button lettering and white headline and button match the brand colours, but nothing on the ad names the carrier.
